children: SoftBank Group (SOBKY) fell 3.69% to 3,416 yen at the November 16 regular-session close in Tokyo, as Asian technology shares slid on spillover from U.S. tech weakness and caution ahead of Nvidia's earnings. The Nikkei 225 lost 2.42%. SoftBank is the most concentrated listed proxy for OpenAI, which competes with Anthropic for investor money as Anthropic heads to market this week.

The latest results show how volatile that exposure is. SoftBank posted a July-to-September net loss of 1.1 trillion yen, about $7 billion, against a 2.5 trillion yen profit a year earlier that was driven by a gain on its OpenAI stake, Reuters reported via The Star. SoftBank has spent $64.6 billion for a 13% stake in OpenAI, according to the same report. The company presented its results on November 10.

That $64.6 billion equals about 51% of SoftBank's $126.7 billion market cap, so OpenAI's private valuation effectively anchors half the market value. Anthropic's public debut will give investors a live yardstick, which could help or hurt that mark. GuruFocus gives SoftBank a GF Score of 72/100, reflecting middling profitability and a leveraged balance sheet. At 3,416 yen, shares trade about 9% above the 3,121.69 yen GF Value, which GuruFocus still calls fairly valued. The next test is where Anthropic prices on November 18 and how OpenAI's implied value compares.

title: SoftBank Group Stocks Fall 3.69% as AI Jitters Hit Its $64.6 Billion OpenAI Bet
